narrative.overview: Your taste is a trading card. Scanning someone's card is a trade, and common ground is dealt between the two cards onto a lilac-white table. The world refuses the default chatbot shell and the cream-serif wellness look, and the trading-card metaphor stops at what is earned outside: Glory, titles, stages and counts exist only for verified real-world things (The Earned Outside Rule), never rarity, loot or a currency.
keyCharacteristics: Ink card faces with thick frames in a domain colour, and real Qloo poster art in the windows.
A heavy, slightly expanded display face for names and headings only; a low-vision reading face for everything else.
One orchestrated motion, the deal, then everything rests.
Every action has a tap-only path, with targets of 48px or more and at least 8px between them.

rules.name: The Frame Rule
rules.body: Domain colours are frames, discs and markers, never text on paper.

rules.name: The No Opacity Text Rule
rules.body: Quiet or disabled states never fade text.

rules.name: The Display Is For Names Rule
rules.body: Anybody sets names and headings only.

rules.name: The Easy-Read Rule
rules.body: No symbols as joiners in copy; full short sentences.

rules.name: The Foil Edge Rule
rules.body: Holo foil appears only on a card's frame edge.

dos: Do follow The Earned Outside Rule. Glory, titles, stages, quests and counts exist only for real things done in the real world: verified check-ins, times met, plans that happened. Nothing is earned in chat, by opening the app or by spending money. Nothing ever goes down, breaks, expires or is lost. There is no rarity, no random reward, no loot and no leaderboard of people's Glory. The card world stays a card world: a title is a card you earned at a place, not a currency.
Do deal: bridges fly out once with exponential ease-out and then rest.
Do put real Qloo poster art in every window.
Do label made-up people and characters as made up, and Larry as an AI.
Do keep every target at least 48px with at least 8px between targets.
donts: Don't add rarity, loot, random rewards, metal colours, a currency, or anything earned from chat, app opens, screen time or spending.
Don't use gradient text, glass or blur, eyebrow labels, emoji as icons, or bounce easing.
Don't set coloured text on paper for names or links.
Don't fade text to show a state.
